keyClauses.title: Emergency towing
keyClauses.text: Emergency towing is covered up to 50 miles when the insured vehicle cannot be safely driven after a sudden mechanical failure, road hazard, or collision.

keyClauses.title: Road hazard tire damage
keyClauses.text: Roadside assistance covers dispatch and towing for a disabled vehicle, but does not cover tire replacement, tire purchase, or wheel alignment.

keyClauses.title: Alternative transport
keyClauses.text: Taxi, rideshare, and rental reimbursement are not included unless the policy has the Mobility Plus endorsement.

keyClauses.title: Limited towing
keyClauses.text: The policy covers one tow per incident up to 15 miles to the nearest qualified repair facility.

keyClauses.title: No roadside consumables
keyClauses.text: Fuel, replacement tires, batteries, parts, and shop labor are excluded from Basic Roadside benefits.

keyClauses.title: Collision deductible
keyClauses.text: Collision damage is subject to the listed deductible unless another party accepts liability.

keyClauses.title: Premium towing
keyClauses.text: The policy covers towing up to 100 miles, including EV-certified tow providers where available.

keyClauses.title: Mobility Plus
keyClauses.text: Taxi, rideshare, or rental reimbursement is covered up to 75 USD per day for up to three days when the vehicle is disabled by a covered loss.

keyClauses.title: EV exclusions
keyClauses.text: Battery depletion caused solely by failure to charge is not a covered mechanical failure.

keyClauses.title: Commercial use limitation
keyClauses.text: Roadside assistance applies to light commercial use only and excludes towing while carrying hazardous materials or operating above rated payload.

keyClauses.title: Mobile repair
keyClauses.text: Mobile repair dispatch is covered when a provider can reasonably restore drivability at the roadside.

keyClauses.title: Payload exclusion
keyClauses.text: Damage caused by overloading, improper cargo securement, or payload above manufacturer limits is excluded.

keyClauses.title: Glass coverage
keyClauses.text: Windshield and window glass repair or replacement is covered with no deductible after a covered comprehensive glass loss.

keyClauses.title: Rental reimbursement
keyClauses.text: Rental reimbursement is available after a covered roadside disablement, collision, or comprehensive loss, but not for routine maintenance or non-disabled vehicle service.

keyClauses.title: Roadside towing
keyClauses.text: Towing is covered up to 25 miles to the nearest in-network garage.

keyClauses.title: Remote towing
keyClauses.text: Towing is covered up to 75 miles when the vehicle is disabled on a public road or maintained private access road.

keyClauses.title: Mobile repair priority
keyClauses.text: Mobile repair is dispatched first when the issue is a flat tire, lockout, jump-start, or fuel delivery on a public road.

keyClauses.title: Tire hazard endorsement
keyClauses.text: The tire hazard endorsement covers replacement of one tire damaged by a covered road hazard, subject to availability.

keyClauses.title: EV tow benefit
keyClauses.text: EV towing is covered up to 40 miles to the nearest EV-capable repair or charging facility after a covered roadside event.

keyClauses.title: Charging exclusion
keyClauses.text: Running out of charge due to driver error is not covered, but dispatch to a charging location may be arranged at the customer's expense.

keyClauses.title: No rental endorsement
keyClauses.text: The policy does not include rental, taxi, or rideshare reimbursement.

keyClauses.title: Family transport
keyClauses.text: If children or medically vulnerable passengers are present, the carrier may authorize taxi or rideshare up to 100 USD after a covered disablement.

keyClauses.title: Mobile repair preference
keyClauses.text: Mobile repair should be dispatched before towing when the reported issue is battery, lockout, minor tire puncture, or fuel delivery.

keyClauses.title: Road hazard coverage
keyClauses.text: Road hazard damage to tires and wheels is covered up to 600 USD per incident.

keyClauses.title: Roadside without collision
keyClauses.text: Roadside assistance is active, but the policy does not include first-party collision or comprehensive damage coverage.

keyClauses.title: Tow destination
keyClauses.text: Towing is covered up to 20 miles to the nearest qualified repair facility.

keyClauses.title: Accident damage exclusion
keyClauses.text: Vehicle body damage, parts, and labor after an at-fault accident are not covered under liability-only coverage.

keyClauses.title: Concierge dispatch
keyClauses.text: The carrier may dispatch towing, taxi, or rental support immediately after a covered disablement without waiting for final repair estimate approval.

keyClauses.title: Zero deductible physical damage
keyClauses.text: Covered collision and comprehensive losses have no deductible for the listed vehicle.

keyClauses.title: Premium road hazard
keyClauses.text: Tire, wheel, glass, and cosmetic body damage are covered when caused by sudden road hazard or collision.
